# 佛說首楞嚴三昧經

**ID:** T0642
**Volume:** T15
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 姚秦 鳩摩羅什譯
**Dynasty:** 姚秦
**Date:** 402–412
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0642

## Contributors
- 鳩摩羅什 (A001583)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T642 (two fascicles, alt. titles 首楞嚴經 and 新首楞嚴經; Sanskrit *Śūraṅgamasamādhi-sūtra*) is [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80)'s Yáo-Qín translation of one of the most important early Mahāyāna *samādhi*-sūtras. The *Śūraṅgamasamādhi* is the "Heroic-March Samādhi" of an advanced bodhisattva whose meditative power crushes all obstacles; the text was foundational for the Chinese understanding of bodhisattva *samādhi* and is one of Kumārajīva's most influential translations. **It must be carefully distinguished from the entirely different and pseudepigraphic 大佛頂首楞嚴經 (T945), which despite its similar Chinese title is an independent text composed in China in the eighth century.**

**Abstract**

T642 was translated by Kumārajīva at Cháng'ān between 401 and 413. The Sanskrit text was lost in India but partially reconstructed by Étienne Lamotte from Tibetan and Chinese; Lamotte's *La Concentration de la marche héroïque (Śūraṅgamasamādhisūtra)* (1965) is the standard study and contains a complete French translation of T642. The text is a major source for the Mahāyāna doctrine of the *daśabhūmi* (ten bodhisattva stages), the *upāya-kauśalya* (skill-in-means), and the active beneficent bodhisattva-presence in the world. The bodhisattva [Mañjuśrī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E6%AE%8A) and [Maitreya](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BD%8C%E5%8B%92) play prominent roles. Earlier Chinese versions by [Lokakṣema](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E5%A9%81%E8%BF%A6%E8%AE%96), [Zhī Qiān](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99) and others are recorded in the catalogs but do not survive; T642 (Kumārajīva) and T1042 (a Tang-period dhāraṇī text bearing a related name) are the only Chinese versions extant.
